title: Replace logo with uploaded token image without modifications

requirements.summary: Replace current logo on login page with token image without modifications
acceptanceCriteria: The uploaded token image is displayed as the logo on the login page
No frame, border, background, or visual modifications are applied to the token image
The token image is properly sized and positioned where the logo appears

file_operations.description: Replace the LivSpan logo reference with the uploaded token image (frontend/public/assets/IMG_8398-1.png). Remove any surrounding frames, borders, backgrounds, or styling that would modify the token's appearance. Ensure the image is displayed cleanly where the current logo appears on the login card for unauthenticated users.

requirements.summary: Replace current logo on dashboard with token image without modifications
acceptanceCriteria: The uploaded token image is displayed as the logo on the dashboard
No frame, border, background, or visual modifications are applied to the token image
The token image is properly sized and positioned where the logo appears

file_operations.description: Replace the LivSpan logo reference in the loading screen with the uploaded token image (frontend/public/assets/IMG_8398-1.png). Remove any surrounding frames, borders, backgrounds, or styling that would modify the token's appearance. Ensure the image is displayed cleanly during the loading state before the dashboard renders.
